title: The Horizon of the Kuiper Line
author: Ada Whitlock
blurb: Xanthe Amberdale, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
